!!! info "Two namespaces, one origin"

    **`Vhi.*`** is VHI's hand-written C# - what runs in the Godot scene. The one gRPC
    service lives here: [`Vhi.VhiControlService`](Vhi.VhiControlService.md) renders what
    an application *controls* and coordinates the recording session a capture pipeline
    drives it through.

    **`Myogestic.Vhi.*`** is auto-generated by `Grpc.Tools` at build time
    from [`proto/myogestic_vhi.proto`](../grpc-api.md#the-full-contract): the
    typed request / reply messages, the `Kind` enum, and the server stub that service
    implements. The namespace name follows protobuf convention - the same `.proto` is
    also vendored on the MyoGestic side. Edit the `.proto` (not these files) to change
    the wire contract.

    The legacy `Myogestic.Vhi.V1.*` namespace, the separate `VhiTrainingAid` service, and
    the `ContinuousEncoding` enum are all gone; a client that still speaks the old
    contract receives `UNIMPLEMENTED`.
